exposure: giving birth during the COVID-19 pandemic
Timing of delivery (during COVID-19 pandemic vs. pre-pandemic)
cohort: 237 women who gave birth at two hospitals in New York City
finding: Women who gave birth during the peak of the COVID-19 pandemic response, those who were SARS-CoV-2 positive, Black women, and Latina women experienced lower birth satisfaction and higher perceived health care discrimination, which in turn were associated with negative postpartum health outcomes.
